records.failureSummary: Implemented the HTTP server, configuration bootstrap, JSON response/error-envelope utilities, method+path router and unauthenticated health endpoints for slice-1 (AC-01), using only Node standard library modules and logging to stdout only. New modules: src/config.mjs (validates PORT as a decimal port in [0,65535] with default 3000, resolves DATA_DIR with default ./data, rejects NUL-byte paths, ensureDataDir makes the directory recursively and verifies it is a directory), src/http/responses.mjs (sendJson with Content-Type application/json and Content-Length, sendError emitting the {"error":{"code","message"}} envelope, sendHtml, sendNoContent, sendNotFound), src/http/router.mjs (Router with add/get/post/put/patch/delete, segment matching with :params, safe URL parsing, 8KB URL cap, trailing-slash normalization, HEAD-as-GET, and a JSON 404 NOT_FOUND for unknown paths or unsupported methods on known paths), and src/health.mjs (GET /healthz, /health, /ready all return 200 {"status":"ok"} with no auth and no DATA_DIR reads). src/server.js now builds the app from config/router/health, ensures DATA_DIR, wires POST /api/register and the home page with its four data-testid elements, maps ApiError to the PRD envelope, adds JSON clientError handling plus header/request/keep-alive timeouts, and keeps exported createApp/start/createRequestHandler for existing consumers. src/config.js and src/http-utils.js were converted to thin re-export shims so prior imports keep working; src/tools/typecheck.mjs now also loads and checks the new modules. No API contract changed: health bodies are byte-for-byte {"status":"ok"}, JSON responses keep application/json, unknown routes return 404 with the standard envelope, and package.json dependencies remain empty. Verification: pnpm test 37/37 pass (including all [AC-01] health cases and the existing registration suites), pnpm lint ok (14 files), pnpm typecheck ok (13 modules), pnpm build ok.
